answer: Temporal TTL binds identity to continuous presence. Each agent must re-attest or re-answer within a short window; expired credentials lose weight in the current epoch. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must keep every sockpuppet online and generating fresh context every few hours, raising Sybil cost far above any reward. On the terrace of shared history the delta between real and forged trajectories becomes a bright comet trail that peers simply refuse to countersign.
